extent_definition: Envelope of exported object bounding boxes; not a tissue ROI or anatomical registration
interpretation: Condition follows the same left/right exported layout in every source-image/arm panel. This flags a technical-review priority; it does not establish an imaging artifact.
action: Review source-image/composite provenance, illumination and background correction, HALO threshold uniformity, and equivalent blinded fields from both sides. Shared image IDs do not establish matched experimental pairs or remove layout confounding.
